name: Sicily

flag.description: Divided diagonally from the upper hoist, red above and yellow below, with the trinacria in the centre: the winged head of Medusa with three bent running legs and three ears of wheat.
flag.symbolism: The three legs stand for the island's three capes and the wheat for its fertile land; red and yellow are said to be the colours of Palermo and Corleone, allies in the Sicilian Vespers revolt of 1282.

hook: Sicily is three running legs around Medusa's face on red and yellow halves; the Isle of Man's three armoured legs run on plain red.
trivia: Trinacria, "three-pointed" in Greek, was an ancient name for triangular Sicily.
Although the trinacria is ancient, the flag only became official by regional law in 2000.
